universe_note:
Chain-level campaign-v1 screen (identity_schema campaign-v1, scenario_id null), first run for this chain. Universe built per LINK across the whole 13-link chain, worked in priority order: the one money-corner link first, then the two CHOKE_POINT links, then the rest by chain position. The mapping (data/mappings/russian-diesel-ban.json, 27 issuers, 27 placements) carries a fresh-context census audit dated 2026-09-04T03:32:44Z (atlas-fresh-context) that returned status FAIL: not on any evidence defect (41 of 41 sampled placement/listing/search checks came back clean) but because 12 of 13 link_coverage rows are still OPEN and none are TARGET_MET, so method section 6A's COMPLETE gate cannot be met yet. Mapping status stays ACTIVE. Every row this run therefore rests on Ron's 2026-09-01 PLACEMENT-scope rule: audit_scope 'PLACEMENT' declared on the row, admitted only when the consumed placement's role evidence is entirely VERIFIED. All 27 of this mapping's placements clear that mechanical bar (every placement carries only VERIFIED evidence tags, none INFERRED), so admissibility here turns entirely on whether the issuer has a COMPLETE O1/O2 profile on disk: 7 of the 27 do (ALBEMARLE, BHARAT-PETROLEUM, CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL, FRONTLINE, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES, TEEKAY-TANKERS); of those, FRONTLINE and TEEKAY-TANKERS are BLOCKED at O3 and refused, leaving 5 mechanically admissible. This run seats 4 of those 5 and documents why the fifth is declined on judgment, not on any gate failure.

hydroprocessing-catalysts [MONEY CORNER, UNDISCOVERED]: searched and empty. ALBEMARLE is the mapping's sole placement (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence citing an April 2025 10-Q: 'Owns the Ketjen catalyst business whose Refining Solutions unit supplies refining catalysts') and its profile is COMPLETE O2, so it mechanically clears every check_screen.py bar. This session declines to seat it anyway. Albemarle's own Q2 2026 8-K earnings-release exhibit, fetched and on disk at data/edgar/docs/ALB.json (accession 0000915913-26-000101, filed 2026-08-05), states verbatim: 'During the first quarter of 2026, the Company divested its controlling ownership interest in its Refining Solutions business and its full 50% ownership interest in the Eurecat joint venture.' Ketjen's Refining Solutions unit is the entire basis of the mapping's role claim, and as of Q1 2026 Albemarle no longer controls it and no longer holds any stake in the Eurecat JV. The placement's evidence (10-Q dated 2025-04-30) predates the March 2026 divestiture by roughly a year and is now stale in a way that reverses the claim it supports, the same class of finding that led the fresh-context WORLD-KINECT placement on hormuz-maritime to be declined on judgment today rather than seated on a technically-VERIFIED tag. Seating ALBEMARLE here would put the chain's only money-corner name in front of Ron on a business the issuer sold five months before this screen ran. Not fixed here: data/mappings/ is outside this run's write scope; flagged to tasks/backlog.md for Atlas to re-evidence or close this placement (REJECTED or SUPERSEDED, with a current role claim) before it is offered again. The money-corner link is therefore genuinely empty this run, not merely unscreened.

crude-feedstock [OVER_CROWDED]: searched and empty. Sole placement CONOCOPHILLIPS (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence) has no profile on disk; not screened for lack of a COMPLETE O1/O2, this run screens only.

refinery-hydrogen [QUIET]: searched and empty. Sole placement AIR-PRODUCTS (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence) has no profile on disk.

hydroprocessing-technology [QUIET]: searched and empty. Sole placement KBR-INC (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence) has no profile on disk.

turnaround-and-catalyst-services [QUIET]: searched and empty. Both placements, MATRIX-SERVICE and MISTRAS-GROUP (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence each), have no profile on disk.

russian-refining-attrition [CHOKE_POINT, OVER_CROWDED]: searched and empty. Zero mapped placements: the census closed this link EXHAUSTED with no qualifying public issuer, exactly as the chain's own bottleneck note states (Rosneft, Lukoil, Gazprom Neft and Surgutneftegas are sanctioned and unreachable from this venue).

shipyard-newbuild-capacity [CROWDED]: attributed. KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence citing two dated VLCC-delivery press releases) has a COMPLETE O2 profile and is seated (picks_and_shovels; shipbuilding is one of several Kawasaki segments, so exposure is partial). That profile was written under tibet-mega-dam (tunneling-tbm) and has not yet been amended with a russian-diesel-ban placement entry of its own; the row's identity and thesis instead rest on this chain's own mapping placement, which is independently sourced and all-VERIFIED (method section 6A treats a profile as reusable across chains; check_screen.py qualifies a row on the mapping placement plus profile status/tier, not on the profile's own placements list naming this exact chain). Flagged in data_gaps for the next profile batch to backfill. The second placement, CSSC-OFFSHORE-MARINE-ENGINEERING (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED), has no profile on disk.

conversion-capacity [CHOKE_POINT, OVER_CROWDED]: searched and empty. All 6 placements are ACTIVE with all-VERIFIED role evidence (MARATHON-PETROLEUM, VALERO-ENERGY, PHILLIPS-66, PBF-ENERGY, HF-SINCLAIR, PAR-PACIFIC-HOLDINGS) but none has a COMPLETE data/companies/<issuer_id>.json profile yet; this run screens only, it does not write profiles. This is the chain's own flagged exception (the note calls out 'coverage is dense at the US large-cap end') and the depth is real in the mapping, just entirely unprofiled.

refinery-capacity-response [UNDISCOVERED]: attributed. BHARAT-PETROLEUM and CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL both have COMPLETE O2 profiles already written and amended for this exact chain and link (their placements[] arrays name russian-diesel-ban/refinery-capacity-response directly) and are seated (second_order). HINDUSTAN-PETROLEUM and INDIAN-OIL (both ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence) have no profile on disk.

clean-product-shipping [CROWDED]: attributed. INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence citing its 2024 10-K) has a COMPLETE O2 profile and is seated (pure_play). That profile was written under hormuz-maritime (crude-tanker-tonnage) and, like KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES above, has not yet been amended with a russian-diesel-ban placement entry; same treatment, same data_gaps flag. SCORPIO-TANKERS (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED) has no profile on disk. TEEKAY-TANKERS and FRONTLINE both have profiles but are BLOCKED at O3 and refused; not screen-eligible regardless of their placement evidence.

storage-and-blending-terminals [QUIET]: searched and empty. Sole placement KINDER-MORGAN (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence) has no profile on disk.

wholesale-fuel-distribution [QUIET]: searched and empty. Both placements, SUNOCO-LP and GLOBAL-PARTNERS-LP (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence each), have no profile on disk.

diesel-demand-anchor [OVER_CROWDED]: searched and empty. Both placements, OLD-DOMINION-FREIGHT-LINE and DEERE (ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED role evidence each), have no profile on disk. Exposure here is negative by the chain's own framing (a diesel-intensive fleet is short this chain), so an unprofiled state is lower priority than the supply-side links.

Net effect: 3 of 13 links produce rows (4 rows total); the money-corner link and both CHOKE_POINT links are attributed as searched-and-empty with a stated reason, never silently absent. The single largest concrete next step is `run profile --campaign CAMP-20260901-01` prioritizing conversion-capacity (a CHOKE_POINT with 6 admissible, unprofiled names) and refinery-capacity-response (2 more admissible names beyond the 2 already seated), both already past the VERIFIED-evidence bar. A second, smaller step is a `run universe russian-diesel-ban` amendment closing or re-evidencing the ALBEMARLE/hydroprocessing-catalysts placement now that its Refining Solutions business is divested, which would either restore the money corner with a corrected role or free it to be reassigned.

GATE DEFECT FOUND AND WORKED AROUND BY DROPPING ROWS (not by inventing data): tools/check_screen.py's campaign-identity check compares `listing.get("ticker")` against BOTH `row.get("ticker")` and `row.get("market_ticker")` (line 384-386), instead of comparing `listing.get("market_ticker")` against `row.get("market_ticker")`. Every campaign-v1 row committed to date is a US T1 listing where ticker==market_ticker by coincidence, so this never fired. It fires here: this mapping's foreign listings correctly carry a bare exchange ticker (BPCL, 00386, 7012) separate from a vendor-suffixed market_ticker (BPCL.NS, 0386.HK, 7012.T), matching the convention used everywhere else in this repo including the issuer profiles themselves. Writing row.market_ticker equal to the bare ticker to satisfy the gate would corrupt the row's own identity (data/market/BPCL.json does not exist; the real file is data/market/BPCL-NS.json), so this run declines that workaround. BHARAT-PETROLEUM and CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL (refinery-capacity-response) and KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES (shipyard-newbuild-capacity) are therefore dropped from this screen: mechanically admissible and correctly evidenced, blocked only by this gate defect, not by any data or evidence gap. Flagged to tasks/backlog.md; tools/ is outside this run's write scope. Only INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS survives (a US NYSE listing where ticker==market_ticker), so this run seats 1 row on 1 of 13 links, not the 4 rows on 3 links a clean gate would have allowed.

queries_run.query: mapping placement resolution: every (chain_id, link_id, issuer_id) in data/mappings/russian-diesel-ban.json carrying an ACTIVE status and all-VERIFIED role evidence, joined to its official listing
COMPLETE O1/O2 profiles under data/companies/ whose issuer_id matches a russian-diesel-ban placement

data/edgar/docs/ALB.json full-text search for 'Ketjen', 'catalyst', 'Refining Solutions' to verify the hydroprocessing-catalysts placement's current-tense role claim against Albemarle's own most recent (Q2 2026) earnings-release exhibit
EDGAR earnings documents on disk for the 4 seated names (BPCL.NS, 0386.HK, INSW, 7012.T)

pure_play.name: International Seaways, Inc.
pure_play.thesis_1line: US-listed international tanker owner (~70-vessel fleet including product carriers) whose core business is exactly the clean-product-shipping link: oceangoing transport of crude oil and petroleum products in the International Flag trade, the ton-mile-inflation exposure this link measures as Russian-diesel export routes lengthen and shadow-fleet tonnage is displaced.

theme_revenue_exposure.basis: No diesel-ban-specific or Russian-cargo-specific revenue percentage is disclosed by International Seaways; INSW does not break out route-level or cargo-origin revenue.

revenue_latest_fy.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_latest_fy.basis: Revenues for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31 as reported to SEC XBRL companyfacts for CIK 1679049 (International Seaways, Inc., NYSE: INSW).

revenue_cagr_3y.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Three-year compound annual revenue growth computed as (843302000 / 864665000) ** (1/3) - 1 from the companyfacts Revenues series, fiscal year ended 2022-12-31 to fiscal year ended 2025-12-31; effectively flat despite the 2026 rate spike, since the spike is a 2026 event and FY2025 already lapped the post-2022 tanker cycle peak.

operating_margin.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_margin.basis: OperatingIncomeLoss 345385000 divided by Revenues 843302000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, both from companyfacts.

fcf_margin.basis: capex_fy in data/market/INSW.json fundamentals last reports 2018-12-31 (148946000); no FY2025 or FY2024 capex figure is present in companyfacts, so free cash flow margin cannot be computed for the current fiscal year without mixing a stale capex figure into a current-year ratio.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: Operating cash flow 380052000 divided by net income 309261000, both for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31, from companyfacts.

net_debt_to_ebitda.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt 447021000 (total debt 606418000 less cash 159397000, both as of 2026-06-30) divided by an EBITDA proxy 508971000 (operating income 345385000 plus depreciation 163586000 for the fiscal year ended 2025-12-31), from companyfacts.

piotroski.basis: data/market/INSW.json quality.piotroski state PENDING_DATA: 8 of 9 inputs found, missing cost_of_revenue_fy (companyfacts does not tag a distinct cost-of-revenue concept for this filer).

beneish_state.basis: data/market/INSW.json quality.beneish state PENDING_DATA: 11 of 12 inputs found, missing cost_of_revenue_fy for the same reason as piotroski.

market_cap.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
market_cap.basis: Market capitalization 4881616947.18 computed in data/market/INSW.json quality.derived.market_cap from SEC companyfacts share count 49404078 (as of 2025-12-31) times the close 98.81 of 2026-08-28. The share count is the official SEC figure; the close is the repo's own market plane, not an issuer document.

price_to_sales.source_name: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts, read from data/market/INSW.json fundamentals (source sec-companyfacts)
price_to_sales.basis: Market capitalization 4881616947.18 divided by fiscal year 2025-12-31 revenue 843302000.

implied_fcf_cagr.basis: Free-cash-flow CAGR the current enterprise value 5328637947.18 implies over a 5-year explicit period on base FCF 231106000.0, solved by bisection at a 0.09 discount rate and 0.025 terminal growth over companyfacts statements. Assumption-dependent expectation reading, not a reported figure.

crowdedness.basis: data/market/INSW.json pcs is null; no PCS attention read for this T1 listing this run (method section 6: T2/T3 PCS is COVERAGE-THIN, never a blocker and never estimated).

data_gaps: check_screen.py's campaign-identity ticker check is defective for foreign listings (compares listing.ticker against row.market_ticker instead of listing.market_ticker); it silently blocked 3 otherwise-admissible rows (BHARAT-PETROLEUM, CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL, KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES) this run. See universe_note for the full explanation and tasks/backlog.md for the fix candidate. Not fixed here: tools/ is outside this run's write scope.

Money-corner link hydroprocessing-catalysts is genuinely empty this run: its sole placement (ALBEMARLE) is mechanically admissible (COMPLETE O2, all-VERIFIED evidence) but declined on judgment because Albemarle's own Q2 2026 8-K (data/edgar/docs/ALB.json, accession 0000915913-26-000101) states the Refining Solutions/Ketjen business the placement's role rests on was divested (controlling stake) in Q1 2026, along with the full Eurecat JV stake. Flagged to tasks/backlog.md for Atlas; the placement's role evidence (an April 2025 10-Q) is now stale in a way that reverses the claim.

20 issuers carry ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED mapping placements on this chain but have no profile on disk (admissible-but-unprofiled): crude-feedstock: CONOCOPHILLIPS. refinery-hydrogen: AIR-PRODUCTS. hydroprocessing-technology: KBR-INC. turnaround-and-catalyst-services: MATRIX-SERVICE, MISTRAS-GROUP. shipyard-newbuild-capacity: CSSC-OFFSHORE-MARINE-ENGINEERING. conversion-capacity (CHOKE_POINT): MARATHON-PETROLEUM, VALERO-ENERGY, PHILLIPS-66, PBF-ENERGY, HF-SINCLAIR, PAR-PACIFIC-HOLDINGS. refinery-capacity-response: HINDUSTAN-PETROLEUM, INDIAN-OIL. clean-product-shipping: SCORPIO-TANKERS. storage-and-blending-terminals: KINDER-MORGAN. wholesale-fuel-distribution: SUNOCO-LP, GLOBAL-PARTNERS-LP. diesel-demand-anchor: OLD-DOMINION-FREIGHT-LINE, DEERE. `run profile --campaign` should prioritize conversion-capacity (CHOKE_POINT, 6 names) and refinery-capacity-response (2 more names) first.

TEEKAY-TANKERS and FRONTLINE both carry ACTIVE, all-VERIFIED placements on clean-product-shipping but their profiles are BLOCKED at O3, so they are refused as screen inputs regardless of placement quality; not counted as admissible-but-unprofiled since they are profiled, just not eligible.

The two seated rows on shipyard-newbuild-capacity and clean-product-shipping (KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS) draw on COMPLETE O2 profiles that were written for a different chain (tibet-mega-dam and hormuz-maritime respectively) and have not yet been amended with a russian-diesel-ban placements[] entry of their own; the row's chain-specific identity and thesis rest on this mapping's own placement record instead, which is independently sourced and all-VERIFIED. The next `run profile` pass on either ticker should append the russian-diesel-ban placement so the profile's permanent-memory record matches every chain it has actually been screened into.

No earnings_nuggets are written on any row: only ALBEMARLE (declined) has a fetched EDGAR document on disk (data/edgar/docs/ALB.json); the 4 seated names carry no data/edgar/docs/<T>.json file, so no verbatim quote could be verified this run rather than being fabricated.

Crowdedness is NULL/COVERAGE-THIN on all 4 seated rows: data/market/<T>.json.pcs reads null for BPCL.NS, 0386.HK, INSW and 7012.T alike (INSW is T1 but simply carries no PCS block on disk this run); method section 6 treats T2/T3 PCS as COVERAGE-THIN and never a blocker, and this run does not estimate a NULL read.

changelog.change: First run screen russian-diesel-ban (chain-level, scenario_id null). Built the per-link universe across all 13 links under audit_scope PLACEMENT (mapping FAILs its fresh-context census audit on OPEN-link coverage only; 41/41 sampled checks clean). All 27 placements clear the all-VERIFIED evidence bar; 5 of 27 issuers have a COMPLETE O1/O2 profile. Seated 4: BHARAT-PETROLEUM and CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL on refinery-capacity-response, INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS on clean-product-shipping, KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES on shipyard-newbuild-capacity. Declined the 5th (ALBEMARLE, the chain's sole money-corner candidate) on judgment: its own Q2 2026 8-K discloses the Q1 2026 divestiture of the Refining Solutions/Ketjen business the placement's role evidence rests on, so the money-corner link is documented searched-and-empty rather than seated on stale evidence. Both CHOKE_POINT links (russian-refining-attrition, conversion-capacity) also searched-and-empty, the former by chain design (sanctioned), the latter for lack of any profiled name among 6 admissible placements. Wrote 4 rows across 3 of 13 links; documented every link's disposition in universe_note and named 20 admissible-but-unprofiled issuers plus the ALBEMARLE mapping defect in data_gaps. CORRECTION mid-run: 3 of the 5 candidate rows (BHARAT-PETROLEUM, CHINA-PETROLEUM-AND-CHEMICAL, KAWASAKI-HEAVY-INDUSTRIES) were dropped after tools/check_screen.py rejected them on a ticker/market_ticker comparison defect (it checks listing.ticker against row.market_ticker, not listing.market_ticker); writing a matching but wrong market_ticker to pass the gate was declined as data corruption. Final: 1 row (INTERNATIONAL-SEAWAYS, clean-product-shipping) on 1 of 13 links. Backlogged the gate defect.
